headline: Round 2
caption:
Colby Covington and Dillon Danis are running it back, submission-only this time.
Colby or Danis? 👇

The pair meet in a grappling match at Hype in Rome on Nov 3, after Covington beat Danis 14-4 in wrestling at RAF 7. Danis also faces Arman Tsarukyan at RAF 14 on Oct 23.

Does Danis get revenge?
question: Colby or Danis?
